title: D2-Omni: Encoders, Streaming Inference, and Training
description: A narrated animation of the implemented Qwen D2 80-ms architecture. Animation timing is slowed and schematic.

scenes.title: One timeline. Four positions.
scenes.subtitle: Extend Qwen D2 80 ms with a causal visual stream

sentences.spoken: D two Omni extends the Qwen D two eighty millisecond model with streaming vision.
sentences.caption: D2-Omni extends the Qwen D2 80-ms model with streaming vision.

sentences.spoken: The central idea is one shared timeline: listen to the user, hear the assistant's previous speech, see the scene, and generate text and speech.
sentences.caption: One shared timeline: user audio, previous assistant speech, video, and generated text.

scenes.title: Audio: two streams, shared encoder
scenes.subtitle: One user embedding and one delayed-self embedding every 80 ms

sentences.spoken: Incoming audio is converted to causal log mel features.
sentences.caption: Incoming audio is converted to causal log-mel features.

sentences.spoken: A shared D two audio encoder maintains two independent streaming states: one for the environment, and one for the assistant's delayed playback.
sentences.caption: One shared D2 audio encoder; independent user and self-audio streaming states.

sentences.spoken: Every eighty milliseconds, each lane produces one embedding.
sentences.caption: Each audio lane produces one embedding per 80-ms tick: 12.5 Hz.

sentences.spoken: The first self audio input is silence; subsequent inputs come from the previous generated waveform.
sentences.caption: Self audio starts with silence, then uses the previous generated waveform.

scenes.title: Vision: twelve tokens per image
scenes.subtitle: 1 fps · 96 × 128 pixels (H × W) · frozen native encoder
scenes.chapter: The video encoder and token queue

sentences.spoken: Video is sampled at one frame per second.
sentences.caption: Sample the video at 1 fps; never use a frame before its timestamp.

sentences.spoken: Each independent image is resized to ninety six by one hundred twenty eight pixels and passed through the frozen vision encoder.
sentences.caption: Resize each independent image to 96 × 128 pixels and use the frozen vision encoder.

sentences.spoken: Spatial merging produces twelve visual tokens, plus matching Deep Stack features.
sentences.caption: Spatial merging produces 12 visual tokens, with matching DeepStack features.

sentences.spoken: The queue releases one token per audio tick.
sentences.caption: Release one queued visual token per 80-ms audio tick.

sentences.spoken: Because the clock is twelve point five hertz, two seconds contain twenty four visual tokens and one visual padding position.
sentences.caption: 25 ticks in 2 seconds = 24 visual tokens + 1 visual padding position.

sentences.spoken: At stream start, prefill the task's system prompt once.
sentences.caption: Prefill the task-specific system prompt once at stream start.

sentences.spoken: At tick i, append the user audio embedding, the delayed self audio embedding, and the next visual token.
sentences.caption: Call 1: prefill [user audio U[i], delayed self audio A[i], visual token V[i]].

sentences.spoken: Then append the previous text token and predict the current text or control token.
sentences.caption: Call 2: input the previous text token z[i−1], then predict z[i].

sentences.spoken: Together these occupy four ordered Thinker positions.
sentences.caption: Together, the two calls append exactly four ordered Thinker positions.

sentences.spoken: The implementation uses a three position prefill followed by one text step, both sharing the same key value cache.
sentences.caption: The three-position prefill and text step share one persistent Thinker KV cache.

scenes.title: Speak, feed back, and keep going
scenes.subtitle: State is carried from tick i to tick i+1

sentences.spoken: The Thinker provides text and layer twenty four context to D two's response controlled Talker.
sentences.caption: The native response state routes text or layer-24 context into the Talker.

sentences.spoken: The Talker predicts one speech code frame, and the waveform renderer produces the next audio chunk.
sentences.caption: Talker → speech-code frame → waveform renderer → the next 80 ms of audio.

sentences.spoken: Feed that generated waveform back into the self audio encoder on the following tick.
sentences.caption: Generated speech S[i] becomes self-audio feedback on tick i+1.

sentences.spoken: Keep both Thinker and Talker state.
sentences.caption: Carry the Thinker cache, Talker cache, codec history, and audio stream state.

sentences.spoken: Text may finish before speech; continue the audio loop until the Talker's codec end token or an interrupt.
sentences.caption: Continue after text completion: speech ends on codec EOS or an INTERRUPT.

scenes.title: Training starts with the task prompt
scenes.subtitle: InstructS2S and AVQA keep their different native D2 prompts

sentences.spoken: Training uses only Instruct S two S and A V Q A.
sentences.caption: The current recipe uses only InstructS2S and AVQA.

sentences.spoken: Instruct S two S uses D two's conversation prompt and an encoded fixed random placeholder image.
sentences.caption: InstructS2S: conversation prompt + fixed random image encoded by the frozen tower.

sentences.spoken: A V Q A uses D two's original multiple choice prompt and the full real video, aligned with its scene audio.
sentences.caption: AVQA: original multiple-choice prompt + full real video aligned with scene audio.

sentences.spoken: The prompt is ordinary text at the beginning of a same task conversation, before the interleaved stream.
sentences.caption: Prepend ordinary system-prompt tokens once, before the same-task interleaved stream.

scenes.title: Training interleaves the same four lanes
scenes.subtitle: Ground-truth previous text and codec inputs provide teacher forcing

sentences.spoken: The training sequence repeats the same four positions at every audio tick.
sentences.caption: Training repeats [U[i], A[i], V[i], previous text] at every 80-ms tick.

sentences.spoken: User audio, delayed reference self audio, and visual features align by timestamp.
sentences.caption: Align user audio, delayed reference self audio, and visual features by timestamp.

sentences.spoken: The text input is the previous reference token; its target is the current token.
sentences.caption: Thinker text input: previous reference token. Target: current reference token.

sentences.spoken: Speech codec inputs are shifted reference codes as well.
sentences.caption: Talker also receives shifted reference codec inputs during training.

sentences.spoken: This is teacher forcing during training. Inference instead uses the model's own previous text, codes, and generated self audio.
sentences.caption: Training uses reference history; inference uses generated text, codes, and self audio.

sentences.spoken: Concatenate same task examples until the conversation is at least seven hundred twenty seconds.
sentences.caption: Concatenate same-task examples until the conversation is at least 720 seconds.

sentences.spoken: Then train in ninety second chunks: one thousand one hundred twenty five ticks, or forty five hundred stream positions.
sentences.caption: One 90-s chunk = 1,125 ticks × 4 = 4,500 stream positions; the initial prompt is extra.

sentences.spoken: Carry the previous ninety seconds of key value memory into the next chunk, but detach it from gradients.
sentences.caption: Carry 90 seconds of KV memory into the next chunk and stop gradients through it.

sentences.spoken: Train the current chunk only.
sentences.caption: Backpropagate through the current 90-second chunk only.

sentences.spoken: Preserve audio encoder, text, Talker, and playback state across chunk boundaries.
sentences.caption: Carry audio encoder, previous text, Talker, codec, and delayed playback state.

scenes.title: Supervise text and speech together
scenes.subtitle: The native D2 timing and loss rules stay in place

sentences.spoken: Supervise the text readouts and speech codes with weighted cross entropy.
sentences.caption: Optimize the text readouts and speech-code predictions with weighted cross entropy.

sentences.spoken: Keep D two's R M S plus six frame response and interrupt placement; speech end follows the last audible frame.
sentences.caption: RESPONSE / INTERRUPT: RMS anchor +6 frames. Speech EOS: last audible frame +1.

sentences.spoken: Our continuation uses a speech end weight of five and text control weights of twenty.
sentences.caption: Current CE weights: speech-code EOS ×5; text RESPONSE / INTERRUPT ×20.

sentences.spoken: The vision encoder stays frozen.
sentences.caption: The vision encoder stays frozen; train the native D2 SFT parameter groups.

sentences.spoken: The architecture is the same in both modes: a task prompt, followed by time aligned four position groups.
sentences.caption: Both modes use the same architecture: task prompt + time-aligned four-position groups.

prompts.conversation: You are a helpful spoken conversational assistant. Respond naturally when the user finishes speaking.
prompts.avqa: You are answering a multiple-choice audio question. Respond with the correct choice letter followed by the corresponding option wording.
